fts.index: function(doc){var fields=['fname','lname','full_name','content','user','name','display_name','legal_name','group','channel','platform','domain','url','target','claim','term','org_type'];var data=(doc.data&&typeof doc.data==='object')?doc.data:{};function add(name,value){if(value===undefined||value===null){return;}if(Array.isArray(value)){value.forEach(function(item){add(name,item);});return;}if(typeof value==='string'||typeof value==='number'||typeof value==='boolean'){index(name,value,{'store':true});}}add('dataset',doc.dataset);add('dtype',doc.dtype);add('title',doc.title);add('summary',doc.summary);if(Array.isArray(doc.sources)){doc.sources.forEach(function(source){if(typeof source==='string'){add('sources',source);}else if(source&&typeof source==='object'){['name','title','url','uri','publisher','author'].forEach(function(key){add('sources',source[key]);});}});}fields.forEach(function(field){add(field,data[field]!==undefined?data[field]:doc[field]);});if(doc.schema_org){add('sameAs',doc.schema_org.sameAs);}}
